rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own home structure (basement floor, drywall) and contents caused by failure of the policyholder's own plumbing system is classic property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Claimant returned from work trip to find basement flooded with approximately two inches of standing water caused by a burst supply line under an upstairs bathroom sink that ran for two days. Hardwood flooring is buckled, drywall soaked to one foot high, and stored contents destroyed. Significant water damage to structure and contents with potential for hidden moisture damage and mold.

case_facts.description: approximately two inches of water throughout basement; hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to one foot high, stored boxes damaged
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is textbook property_damage coverage.
claim_summary: Wind damage claim for four shingles blown off the back porch overhang. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no secondary damage or water intrusion. Low-severity property damage claim ready for roofer assignment.

case_facts.description: wind damage - four shingles blown off
